basic_info.description: At 360 Guerrero, effortless living meets world-class culture, cuisine, & community right outside your door! Wake up in the heart of Mission Dolores in this rare 2BR/1BA top floor gem. This spacious condo boasts a generous primary suite w/walk-in closet, updated kitchen, cozy fireplace, & private balcony overlooking tranquil garden views & walking paths. Addl amenities include secure parking, fitness center, sauna, & guest parking. This close-knit community fosters a warm, neighborly atmosphere making it a truly welcoming place to call home.     Step outside & savor the best of San Francisco: enjoy a pastry from Tartine Bakery, indulge in small-batch ice cream at Bi-Rite Creamery, share wood-fired Italian pizza at Delfina, experience bold Argentine flavors at Lolinda, or relax with a cocktail at the historic Twin Peaks Tavern. Dolores Park & the vibrant Valencia Street corridor are just moments away, placing you at the heart of one of SF's most iconic neighborhoods. With an outstanding Walk Score of 98, every urban convenience is within easy reach. The 16th St Mission BART station is just blocks away, offering quick access to downtown in 15 minutes. Destinations such as the Financial District, Ferry Building, Golden Gate Park, and Market Street all within 20 minutes by transit.
